description_en: Performs a paged query on image caches in a workspace, and supports paging and filtering by image source and cache status
description_zh: 分页查询工作空间的镜像缓存，支持按镜像来源和缓存状态筛选
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-image-caches --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --workspace-id ws-example --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListImageCaches

parameters.help_en: The product entry region. This parameter is passed as a query parameter and must match the selected region endpoint and the workspace region
parameters.help_zh: 产品入口地域，以 query 参数传入；必须与所选地域端点及 Workspace 地域一致
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Performs a case-insensitive literal substring search on the full source image reference in the registry/repository:tag format. The repository already includes the namespace. If the value is empty after trimming leading and trailing whitespace, it is treated as not provided. Percent signs, underscores, and backslashes are treated as literal characters
parameters.help_zh: 对 registry/repository:tag 完整源镜像引用做不区分大小写的字面子串搜索，repository 已含 namespace；首尾空白去除后为空按未提供处理，百分号、下划线及反斜线均为普通字符
parameters.name: image_ref_contains

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source ACR Enterprise instance. The match must be exact. Empty strings (strings containing no characters) are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源 ACR 企业版实例 ID，精确相等；空字符串非法
parameters.name: acr_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain name of the source registry. The match is exact and case-insensitive. Do not include the protocol, path, or tag. Public network and VPC domain names are not considered equal. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源仓库域名，精确相等且不区分大小写；不含协议、路径或 Tag，公网与 VPC 域名不视为相等；空字符串非法
parameters.name: registry

parameters.help_en: The source namespace. The match is case-sensitive and exact. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源命名空间，区分大小写、精确相等；空字符串非法
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The repository name under the namespace. The match is case-sensitive and exact. Do not include the namespace. If this parameter is specified, the namespace parameter must also be provided. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间下的仓库名，区分大小写、精确相等；不含 namespace，传入时必须同时提供 namespace；空字符串非法
parameters.name: repository

parameters.help_en: The source image tag. The match is case-sensitive and exact. The latest tag is not inferred. Empty strings are invalid
parameters.help_zh: 源镜像标签，区分大小写、精确相等，不推断 latest；空字符串非法
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: Filters by a single cache status. Omit this parameter to query all statuses
parameters.help_zh: 按单一缓存状态筛选；查询全部时省略
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: Omit this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, pass the nextToken from the previous response as is. When paginating, you must keep the filter conditions and maxResults consistent. If you change any of these, you must query the first page again
parameters.help_zh: 首次省略，后续原样回传上一响应的 nextToken；翻页必须保持筛选条件和 maxResults 一致，改变任一项应重新查询首批
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. Default value: 20. If explicitly specified, the value must be an integer from 1 to 100. Otherwise, an InvalidMaxResults error is returned. When paginating, this value must remain the same as the previous page
parameters.help_zh: 未传默认 20；显式传入时必须为 1–100 的整数，否则报 InvalidMaxResults；翻页时必须与上一页保持一致
parameters.name: max_results
